subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord support an opt-in silent preflight STT mode for mention-gated channels, and what transcript retention/provenance and guild/channel config scope should be allowed?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but the feature deliberately transcribes unmentioned user audio and stores transcript context before a normal agent turn, which is a product and privacy/security boundary maintainers must approve.

options.title: Approve narrow opt-in
options.body: Allow a schema-backed per-guild/per-channel default-off option that transcribes audio only after existing allowlist and attachment limits, stores bounded transcript provenance, and suppresses replies until a later mention.

options.title: Defer to channel-wide media retention design
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until a cross-channel policy covers Discord, Signal, WhatsApp, and Telegram history-media retention consistently.

options.title: Reject silent STT
options.body: Close this direction and keep transcription tied to mentioned or otherwise admitted turns only, preserving the current privacy boundary at the cost of this memo workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow opt-in
recommendation.body: Allow a schema-backed per-guild/per-channel default-off option that transcribes audio only after existing allowlist and attachment limits, stores bounded transcript provenance, and suppresses replies until a later mention.
